title: The Media Library Assistant WordPress plugin before 3.44 does not check that the requesting user is allowed to view a…
description: The Media Library Assistant WordPress plugin versions before 3.44 have a vulnerability where the plugin does not verify if the requesting user has permission to view a post before revealing the taxonomy terms assigned to it. This flaw allows any authenticated user, including low-privileged roles such as subscribers, to discover the term assignments of private attachments and posts.
